# modify pop

```{r}
df_pop_dem_cat <- df_pop_dem %>%
  filter(AGE != "total") %>%
  mutate(AGE = str_remove(AGE, "_")) %>%
  mutate(AGE = as.numeric(AGE)) %>%
  mutate(AGE_cat = case_when(AGE %in% 0:49 ~ "0-49",
                             AGE %in% 50:59 ~ "50-59",
                             AGE %in% 60:69 ~ "60-69",
                             AGE %in% 70:79 ~ "70-79",
                             AGE >= 80 ~ "80-"
                             ))
```

df_pop_dem_sa

# panc

```{r}
df_panc <- df_surg_dem %>% 
  filter(str_detect(CLASS_code, "K700|^K702|^K703|^K704")) %>%
  mutate(TX = case_when(str_detect(PRO_name, "腹腔鏡") & !str_detect(PRO_name, "手術用支援機器") ~ "Lap",
                        str_detect(PRO_name, "腹腔鏡") &  str_detect(PRO_name, "手術用支援機器") ~ "Robotic",
                        .default = "Open") ) %>%
  
  
  mutate(LOC = case_when(str_detect(PRO_name, "膵頭") ~ "Head",
                         str_detect(PRO_name, "膵体尾部") ~ "Distal",
                         str_detect(PRO_name, "全摘") ~ "Total",
                         CLASS_code %in% c("K700", "K700-4") ~ "Middle",
                         CLASS_code %in% c("K700-2", "K700-3") ~ "Partial")) %>%
  mutate(TX = factor(TX, levels = c("Open", "Lap", "Robotic"))) %>%
  mutate(LOC = factor(LOC, levels = c("Head", "Distal", "Total", "Middle", "Partial")))
```

```{r}
convert_strip <- function(x){
  if (x == "SUM"){
    return("**n**")
  }
  
  else if (x == "ADJ"){
    return("**n/10<sup>5</sup> people**")
  }
  
  else {
    return(x)
  }
}

 convert_strip <- Vectorize(convert_strip)
```

```{r}
# man kendall test on raw values


df_panc_rkt <- df_panc_sa_long %>%
#  mutate(ID = paste0(SEX, "_", LOC, "_", AGE, "_", CAT)) %>%
  nest(data = - c(SEX, LOC, AGE, CAT)) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data,
                            ~ mmky(.x$VALUE)),
    tau = map_dbl(model, "Tau"),
    p_value = map_dbl(model, "new P-value"),
    slope = map_dbl(model, "Sen's slope")
  )

df_panc_rkt

```


```{r}
get_exp <- function(x){

  if (x > 0.001){
    
    return("")
  }
  
  else {
  
    p <- formatC(x, digits = 1, format = "e", flag = "#")
    
    ex <- p %>% str_extract("(?<=e).+") %>% str_remove_all("(?<=\\-)0+")
    
    return(ex)
  }
}

get_expv <- Vectorize(get_exp)
```

```{r}
get_num <- function(x){

    if (x > 0.001){
    
      p <- formatC(x, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")
      
      return(p)
  }
  
  else {
  
    p <- formatC(x, digits = 1, format = "e", flag = "#")
    
    num <- p %>% str_extract(".+(?=e)")
    
    num <- str_c(num, "×10")
      
    return(num)
  }
}

get_numv <- Vectorize(get_num)
```

```{r}
symbol_p <- function(x){
  if (is.na(x)){
    return(NA)
  }
  
  else if (x < 0.001){
    return("***")
  }
  
  else if (x < 0.01){
    return("**")
  }
  
  else if (x < 0.05) {
    return("*")
  }
  
  else {
   return("")
  }}

symbol_pv <- Vectorize(symbol_p)

```

```{r}
df_panc_rkt_res <- df_panc_rkt %>%
  mutate(slope_label = case_when(abs(slope) < 10 ~ formatC(slope, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#"),
                           .default = round(slope) %>% scales::comma())) %>%
  
  mutate(tau_label = formatC(tau, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")) %>%
  
  mutate(p_num = get_numv(p_value),
         p_exp = get_expv(p_value)) %>%
  
  mutate(across(c(ends_with("_label"), p_exp), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "-", "−"))) %>%
  
  mutate(p_label = purrr::map2(p_num, p_exp, function(x, y){
    c(fmt_txt(x), fmt_txt(y, vert_align = "superscript"))}) ) %>%

  mutate(p_symbol = symbol_pv(p_value))

df_panc_rkt_res
```
